title: Supervised Regression Algorithm Selection
description: Selection of continuous prediction algorithms based on collinearity, feature count, and non-linearity.
conditions: Supervised regression task with continuous numerical target variable
Tabular feature matrix with linear or non-linear predictor interactions
recommended_methods: Ridge Regression (L2 penalty) for multicollinear linear predictors
Lasso Regression (L1 penalty) for sparse feature selection and parameter shrinkage
Gradient Boosted Regressors (LightGBM Regressor / XGBoost Regressor) for non-linear relationships
selection_rules: If number of features P exceeds sample size N, use Lasso or ElasticNet regression
If target variable is strictly positive and right-skewed, train regressor on log1p(target) or use Tweedie/Gamma objective
If relationship exhibits complex step functions or interactions, select Gradient Boosted Trees
limitations: Tree regressors cannot extrapolate beyond the minimum and maximum target values seen during training
Linear models suffer severe bias if true data-generating process has strong non-linear interactions
